scenarios.prompt: Please create a series of tasks for shipping our storage migration: first investigate existing behavior; based on those findings implement the migration; validate it; if validation fails return to implementation; then publish a final report. Keep progress durable across turns.

Set up a loop for our security release. Analyze the issue, patch it, run the tests, and if tests fail go back to patching. Finish once tests pass. I do not need a timer; I just want it to keep its place.

Break release preparation into tasks: update the documentation, audit dependencies, and draft the announcement. They are independent and can be assigned to different people. Do not start an autonomous worker.
Create a loop that checks our deployment every 10 minutes and reports when it becomes healthy. Stop after at most 12 checks.
Set up a loop that keeps improving our documentation until there are no broken internal links. There is no schedule and I do not want separate phases; continue whenever the agent is idle.
Create a task for the authentication regression: first reproduce it, then implement the fix based on the reproduction, run tests, and if tests fail revise the fix before reporting completion.
